articles.title: GHSA: russh: Unbounded memory allocation in agent protocol server via crafted constraint records
articles.summary:
### Summary

`russh_keys::agent::server::add_key` (`russh/src/keys/agent/server.rs:271-319`) spawns a dedicated tokio task for every 5-byte `SSH_AGENT_CONSTRAIN_LIFETIME` record attached to an added key, each cloning the key blob and sleeping for the declared lifetime (up to ~136 years). The loop has no per-request task budget, and spawned tasks are not rolled back when the overall request fails.
